# U103: Amara switches Reviews off: the read-back names what stays, then Reviews leaves the menu, Home and the goal page, its addresses say it is off, History keeps what was said, and Undo brings it all back

- **Belongs to:** the Reviews module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)), and also the Watching module ([its page](../../watching/journeys/U103.md)); it runs with each of them on
- **Requirements:** `REVIEWS-OPTIONAL`, `MODULES`, `HOME-OWNER`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `parity` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U103

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `await box.isChecked() && await see(p, 'Working together').then(() => true, () => false) && await see(p, '6 reviews are set up.').then(() => true, () => false)`, where `const box = p.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Reviews/ })`. Else it says: Features does not show Reviews under Working together, on, with “6 reviews are set up.”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “features”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Switching off asks first: the read-back counts what stays.
- **Step.** Press the “Reviews” tick box.
- **Check:** The “Switch off Reviews in” dialog shows.
- **Check:** It fails if the read-back does not name the 6 reviews: {says.slice(0, 300)}.
- **Check:** It fails if the read-back does not say nothing is deleted.
- _Note:_ Cancel changes nothing.
- Press the “Cancel” button in the “Switch off Reviews in” dialog.
- **Check:** It fails if Cancel switched Reviews off.
- **Step.** Press the “Reviews” tick box.
- **Step.** Press the “Switch off Reviews” button in the “Switch off Reviews in” dialog.
- **Check:** “Reviews is off in” is shown.
- **Check:** “Nothing it saved is lost.” is shown.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ Gone from the menu (and the phone's tabs).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** Home shows.
- The visible menu's items: as their words (`menuWords`).
- **Check:** It fails if the menu still has Reviews: {menu.join(', ')}.
- **Check:** It fails if the phone’s tabs have no People in Reviews’ place: {menu.join(', ')}.
- _Note:_ Home leads Amara, who owns no goals, to the goals she watches that need attention; no review cell.
- **Check:** The “This week’s main action” part (`[data-part="This week’s main action"]`) shows.
- **Check:** It fails if Home’s lead is not “Goals you watch · {n} need attention”: {leadText}.
- **Check:** It fails if Home’s lead has no See them.
- **Check:** It fails if Home still shows a review cell.
- _Note:_ An ask's own words may say "review" ("…to the finance review"); Home itself names no review, session or walk.
- **Check:** It fails if Home still names a review: “{named[0]}”.
- _Note:_ A review's address says it is off, and who can switch it on.
- Go to `/reviews` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Page not found” is shown.
- **Check:** “Reviews is switched off in” is shown (else: the Reviews address does not say Reviews is switched off).
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead?review=weekly` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- _Note:_ The goal's History still has what was said in the review, and its open next step is still on Home.
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead?history=reviews` in the demo.
- **Check:** The History section shows.
- **Check:** It fails if the goal still shows Last time we talked.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** Home shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `kept && stepThere`, where `const hist = p.locator('#history')`; `const kept = /Platform leadership weekly/.test(await hist.innerText())`; `const step = p.locator('.home-side').getByText('Take the runner budget to the finance review', { exact: false })`; `const stepThere = await step.first().isVisible().catch(() => false)`. Else it says: with Reviews off: History {kept ? 'keeps' : 'lost'} what the review said; the next step is {stepThere ? 'still' : 'no longer'} on Home.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'workspace' && c.actorId === 'amara' && c.summary === 'Switched off Reviews')`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: switching Reviews off was not logged.
- _Note:_ Switching on acts at once; off again, then Undo straight after, brings it back.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Reviews” tick box.
- **Check:** “Reviews is on in” is shown.
- **Step.** Press the “Reviews” tick box.
- **Step.** Press the “Switch off Reviews” button in the “Switch off Reviews in” dialog.
- **Check:** “Reviews is off in” is shown.
- Press the last of the “Undo” button.
- **Check:** “Reviews is back on.” is shown.
- **Check:** It fails if Undo said Reviews is back on and left it off.
- Go to `/reviews` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Platform leadership weekly” is shown (else: Reviews did not come back with every review).
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
